text:
```yaml
name: Spellcheck

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  typos:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run typos spellchecker
        uses: errata-ai/typos-action@v1
        with:
          config: .typos.toml
```
